## Overview The generic DCP `ag_rs` path corrects partial attention outputs in batch-major order, then copies them into head-major order for reduce-scatter. Write the correction directly into that physical layout to remove the input layout copy. ## Claims - Remove one layout-copy kernel before reduce-scatter while retaining the logical `[B, H, D]` shape. - Preserve correction arithmetic and the existing in-place path when the tensor already has the required layout. - Leave the post-reduce-scatter layout conversion in place. ## Validation ### Serving evaluation DeepSeek-V2-Lite BF16, 4 H200, TP4/EP4/DCP4, `ag_rs`, default compilation and CUDA Graph settings ```bash MODEL=deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite vllm serve "$MODEL" -tp 4 --port 9256 --enable-expert-parallel -dcp 4 \ --load-format instanttensor --trust-remote-code lm_eval --model local-completions \ --model_args "base_url=http://127.0.0.1:9256/v1/completions,model=$MODEL,num_concurrent=1024" \ --tasks gsm8k vllm bench serve --model "$MODEL" --dataset-name random \ --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256 --random-input-len 4096 \ --random-output-len 512 --request-rate inf --num-prompts 128 --num-warmups 16 # Also: --random-input-len 32768 --random-output-len 128 ``` Actual runs use the downloaded checkpoint and tokenizer paths, matching seeds 1000/1001, and save raw JSON. Servers restart in A/B/B/A order. All included runs completed 128 requests with zero failures and the requested token counts. | Input/output | Metric (median across runs) | Baseline | Changed | Change | |---|---|---:|---:|---:| | 4096/512 | Output tok/s | 7743.64 | 7894.87 | +1.95% | | 4096/512 | Mean TPOT (ms) | 12.15 | 11.94 | −1.70% | ## Details before： after： ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

If you have time, could you take a look, particularly at whether this belongs in the generic path? Thanks!

@@ -101,6 +101,49 @@ def _distributed_run(fn, world_size: int, extra_env: dict[str, str]) -> None:
         assert process.exitcode == 0
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokens", [1, 4])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("base_e", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("strided", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="requires CUDA")
+def test_correct_attn_out_head_major(dtype, tokens, base_e, strided):
+    """Correction keeps values and makes RS input staging a view, even in graphs."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp import CPTritonContext, correct_attn_out
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    source = torch.randn(tokens, 8, 128, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    lses = torch.randn(4, tokens, 8, device="cuda")
+    if strided:
+        source = source.transpose(0, 1).contiguous().transpose(0, 1)
+        lses = lses.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().transpose(1, 2)
+    lses[3, :, 0] = -float("inf")
+    lses[:, :, 1] = -float("inf")
+    lses[1, :, 2] = float("nan")
+    lses[2, :, 3] = float("inf")
+    source[:, 0] = float("nan")
+    expected, expected_lse = correct_attn_out(
+        source.clone(), lses, 3, CPTritonContext(), base_e
+    )
+    context = CPTritonContext()
+
+    def run():
+        return correct_attn_out(
+            source.clone(), lses, 3, context, base_e, output_head_major=True
+        )
+
+    actual, actual_lse = run()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual_lse, expected_lse, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    assert actual.movedim(0, 1).contiguous().data_ptr() == actual.data_ptr()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        replayed, replayed_lse = run()
+    for _ in range(2):
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(replayed, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(replayed_lse, expected_lse, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+

     """Test --dcp-comm-backend config validation."""
